# Decal

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Decal")`

An image projected onto every surface inside a box: a scorch mark, a footprint, a poster or a crack. It lands on parts, terrain and blocks alike, and needs no parent. To place one where a raycast hit, set its `CFrame` to `CFrame.lookAt(hit.Position, hit.Position + hit.Normal)` and give it a size. Parented to a `BasePart`, its `CFrame` is relative to the part and it moves with the part.

By default a decal multiplies the color of the surface after lighting, so the surface keeps its light and shadow. It darkens and tints and cannot make a surface brighter; a white pixel changes nothing. `BlendMode` selects other behavior.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BlendMode` | `Enum.DecalBlendMode` | `Enum.DecalBlendMode.Multiply` | read/write | How the image is combined with the surface: multiplied into it, laid over it, or added to it. |
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | The position and orientation of the box, relative to the parent part if there is one. The image lies along the box's right and up axes and is projected along its look direction. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | A color the image is multiplied by. |
| `Emissive` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How brightly the image glows on its own, in addition to the light that falls on it. 0 is no glow; a value above 1 is bright enough to bloom. It applies to the `Alpha` and `Additive` blend modes only. |
| `Size` | `vector` | `vector.create(2, 2, 1)` | read/write | The width, height and depth of the box, in meters. Only surfaces inside the box receive the image, so a shallow box marks one wall and a deep one wraps around a corner. |
| `Texture` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image to project. Its alpha channel sets how much of it is applied. With no texture, the decal applies `Color` alone. |
| `Transparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the decal is, from 0 (the image as it is) to 1 (invisible). |
